mainEntity.name: How do I know if my stair railing needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your stair railing needs repair if it feels loose, wobbly, or shows visible damage like cracks, splinters, or corrosion. A railing that isn't securely fastened to the wall or newel posts poses a significant safety risk, especially for children or elderly individuals. Checking for movement when light pressure is applied can indicate a need for repair. Ensuring your railing meets current safety standards is a crucial preparation step.
